name: Pastefy
description: Pastefy is a user-friendly online platform that allows you to quickly and securely store and share text, code, or other notes. Perfect for developers, creatives, or anyone who needs to exchange ideas in real time, Pastefy offers a simple way to save and share content without the hassle of sending files back and forth.
short_desc: An easy paste for seamless sharing
author: InteraApps

form_fields.label: Container User (UID:GID)
form_fields.hint: Process user and group ID (UID:GID). Keep 1000:1000 unless custom host permissions are required.
form_fields.pattern_error: Must be a numeric UID:GID (e.g. 1000:1000) or numeric UID (e.g. 1000)
